title: Appending a value to the computation tape
statement: Let $e$ be the exactness flag, let $z$ be a Boolean input word, let $v$ be a Boolean value, and let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $z$. For any lists of previously computed values and output symbols, and any natural numbers $r,h$ satisfying $h+r=|\mathrm{vals}|$, starting in the append state with value $v$, input-head position $p$, value tape storing $\mathrm{vals}$, mark tape $m$, work-head position $h$, and output $\mathrm{out}$, after $r+1$ machine steps the state is the value-rewind state returning to the gate-reading phase, the value tape stores $\mathrm{vals}$ followed by $v$, the mark tape is erased on the integer interval from $h$ through $|\mathrm{vals}|$ inclusive, the input-head position and output are unchanged, and both work-head positions equal $|\mathrm{vals}|-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A list of computed Boolean values
